speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: The Smart Nation and Digital Government Group (SNDGG) aims to harness technology to secure opportunities for all, build trust and safety, and foster an inclusive Singapore community.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We work closely with other Government agencies to ensure technology bolsters Singapore’s resilience and improves the lives of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Digital technology offers significant opportunities for businesses, people and Government agencies.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: SNDGG will enable all to seize these benefits through close partnerships with Government agencies, industries and research players, and with robust digital and cyber-physical infrastructure anchored by a strong Digital Government.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: First, SNDGG will leverage technology to facilitate the business activity, growth and innovation of Singapore-based enterprises.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will work closely with ServiceSG to redesign whole-of-Government service delivery.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: This includes promoting the use of common digital platforms across Government and building up the Government’s data sharing and data usage architecture.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: As more of our lives and Government services move to the digital space, it is essential to maintain trust in public institutions and secure the digital platforms hosting these services, so people feel safe and protected against scams.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: This will set Singapore apart from other world-leading digital hubs.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also continue to move more eligible Government systems to Cloud to improve resilience, security monitoring and threat detection.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will support the National Crime Prevention Council and the Singapore Police Force to foster a culture of vigilance and contribution to scam prevention through applications like ScamShield.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Together with ServiceSG, SNDGG will ensure that citizen services offered by public agencies remain accessible for less digitally adept Singaporeans, such as seniors and people with disabilities.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Non-digital touchpoints and assistance will be made available to these groups of Singaporeans, wherever possible and necessary.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: SNDGG will also empower our people to use digital tools to participate fully in society.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will support efforts by MCI to promote digital skills and literacy in our people, such as the Digital for Life movement led by the Infocomm Media Development Authority, which galvanises the community to help citizens of all ages and from all walks of life embrace lifelong digital learning.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Digital technologies will empower Singapore to discover new opportunities and make our mark on the world.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: With our people, private and public sector partners, SNDGG is committed to building a Smart Nation where everyone has a place.
